Q01.evidence: Even though citizen scientists may not have science degrees or long, white lab coats, they are still capable of making valuable contributions to science. / The next great scientific achievement could be made by citizen scientists ...
issues: 자족성: 'these two projects'가 발췌 밖(Galaxy Zoo)을 가리킴. 발췌 안에는 STEVE 한 사례뿐이고 첫 문장 'the phenomenon'도 선행 대상 없음.
너무 쉬움: 오답 ①②④⑤가 Only/only/in decline/too ordinary 등 상식·단정 표현으로 바로 제거됨. 정답 'contributions ... science'가 본문 낱말과 직접 일치.

Q02.evidence: his job there was dull and time-consuming. (exciting·tiny amount of time과 모순) / this would require a tremendous amount of time.
issues: ⑤는 'This might sound exciting'의 표면 낱말을 끌어온 이중 오류라 난도가 낮음(허용 범위).

Q03.evidence: the group members began to notice something strange appearing in the night sky ... They realized that the group had discovered a new type of phenomenon that had never been properly studied.

Q04.evidence: In reality, science belongs to everyone, and we all have the ability to play a role in the advancement of science.
issues: 단순 일치: 정답 'play a valuable role in advancing science'가 주장 문장 표현과 거의 그대로 겹침.
출제 범위: 주장 판단과 무관한 Schawinski 사례 도입 3문장이 붙어 'He had to classify around one million images...'에서 이야기가 중간에 끊김. 주장 유형이면 도입 단락까지만 쓰거나 사례 전체를 포함해 제시 범위 전체를 평가하도록 재설계 권장.

Q05.evidence: If it had not been for those participants, Schawinski couldn't have classified that many images. / Galaxy Zoo has now grown into Zooniverse ... about 2 million registered users worldwide.
issues: 자족성 경미: 'those participants', 'Schawinski'가 발췌 첫 부분에 소개 없이 등장(판단에는 지장 없음).

Q06.evidence: There were unusual ribbons of green and purple light, some of which seemed to stretch for thousands of kilometers.
issues: 단순 낱말 일치: 정답 ②가 본문 문장을 거의 그대로 옮김(some of ... seemed to stretch for thousands of kilometers). 예: 'Some of the lights appeared to extend over a vast distance.' 등으로 바꿔 쓰기 제안.

Q07.evidence: neither of them had any idea what Steve was ... it did not resemble anything they had seen before.

Q08.evidence: 주어진 글 'this perception is far from the truth' → (B) 'In reality, science belongs to everyone ... Let's take a look at two of them.' → (C) Kevin Schawinski 소개·'classify around one million images' → (A) 'Since they all looked similar ...'의 they = images.

Q09.evidence: them = the dedicated members of the aurora chasers group, it = STEVE; 'deserve the credit for discovering STEVE' 직후에 와야 함. ③④ 위치는 이미 연구 중인 STEVE와 'remained unnoticed'가 충돌, ①은 them 선행사 없음.
issues: 자족성: 지문 후반 'these two projects'가 발췌 밖 Galaxy Zoo를 가리킴(정답 판단에는 영향 없음).

Q10.evidence: He had to classify around one million images ... It took Schawinski a whole week to classify just 50,000 galaxies. / launching a crowdsourced online project ... with a very basic design and an easy-to-use interface.
issues: Q11 오류어 complicated를 넣어도 'very basic design, easy-to-use interface'가 남아 제목 ⑤ 근거는 유지됨(공유 장문 상호 훼손 없음).

Q11.evidence: ④ complicated → simple: 'with a very basic design and an easy-to-use interface. This allowed ... to get started quickly.'

Q12.evidence: The website was kept as simple as possible ... more than 80,000 individuals participated ... If it had not been for those participants, Schawinski couldn't have classified that many images.
issues: 오답 ②③④⑤가 모두 본문과 정반대라 난도 낮음(허용 범위).

Q13.evidence: It took Schawinski a whole week to classify just 50,000 galaxies. / Schawinski ... complained about the situation.
issues: 함축 표적이 비유성이 약해 문자 그대로 읽어도 풀림(난도 낮음).
발문 조사: 'what about the remaining 950,000가' — 영어 발음(thousand, 받침 있음) 기준이면 '~이'가 자연스러움. 조사 표기 통일 확인 권장.

Q14.evidence: ④ 'Some astronomers still prefer to observe galaxies through huge telescopes...'는 참여자 덕분의 분류 성과라는 흐름과 무관; 제거 시 ③ 'Schawinski couldn't have classified'→⑤ 'it would have taken him decades'가 바로 이어짐.

Q15.evidence: (A) something strange ... neither of them had any idea what Steve was → mysterious; (B) NASA funded a citizen science project involving the public ... asked ordinary people to gather photos → participation.

Q16.evidence: Even though ... (양보) they are still ___ → 긍정 필요; 'ordinary people who desire to help advance science', 'The next great scientific achievement could be made by citizen scientists'.
issues: 같은 mock2 회차 정답 노출: Q16 지문에 'If it had not been for them, it might have remained unnoticed forever.'가 원형으로 있어 같은 회차 Q18(⑤ famous→unnoticed)의 정답을 그대로 알려 줌. Q16 발췌 범위 조정 또는 Q18 표적/회차 재배치 필요.

Q17.evidence: Experts have acknowledged that it is the dedicated members of the aurora chasers group that deserve the credit for discovering STEVE.
issues: 정답 'Dedicated'가 본문 'dedicated members'와 직접 일치(경미).

Q18.evidence: ⑤ famous → unnoticed: 'If it had not been for them [the aurora chasers], it might have remained famous forever'는 발견 공로 문맥과 모순.
issues: 같은 회차(mock2) 정답 노출: Q16 지문에 'it might have remained unnoticed forever', 'In honor of the aurora chasers'가, Q15 지문에 'They confirmed ...', 'properly studied', 'gather photos'가 원형으로 실려 ①~⑤ 전체의 원어가 회차 안에서 확인 가능. 회차 간 지문 배치 재조정 제안.

Q19.evidence: You can become one as well if you have curiosity and an interest in taking part in scientific research. / they are still capable of making valuable contributions to science.
issues: 자족성: 첫 문장 'If it had not been for them, it might have remained unnoticed forever.'의 them/it 선행 대상이 발췌에 없음. 'these two projects'도 발췌 밖을 가리킴. 발췌 시작을 'In honor of the aurora chasers...' 또는 그 앞으로 당기거나 첫 문장을 빼는 방안 제안.
정답 ①의 'should'는 본문의 'You can become one as well'보다 다소 강하지만 주장 유형 정답으로 허용 가능.

Q20.evidence: 주어진 글(Internet 제안) → (C) 'Eventually ... launching ... Galaxy Zoo. The website was kept as simple as possible' → (A) 'This allowed ... to get started quickly ... brief tutorial' → (B) 'Then they were shown an image...'

Q21.evidence: 'more than 75 million classifications' 뒤, 'In fact, it would have taken him decades on his own' 앞: him의 선행사 Schawinski와 In fact의 부연 대상이 주어진 문장에만 있음.

Q22.evidence: There are many interesting theories about STEVE, but none of them have been proven for certain.
issues: ⑤가 본문 문장을 단순 부정한 형태라 쉬움(허용 범위). ①~④는 본문 순서대로 거의 그대로 바꿔 쓴 수준.

Q23.evidence: They were similar in appearance to auroras, yet ... (양보 대조) → 다른 특징; 'Unsure of what they were'.

Q24.evidence: In reality, science belongs to everyone ... / He had to classify around one million images ... It took Schawinski a whole week to classify just 50,000 galaxies ... 'But what about the remaining 950,000?'
issues: 공유 장문 둘째 단락이 mock1 Q10·Q11 공유 장문 첫 단락과 동일하고 'dull' 어휘 표적도 두 회차에서 반복됨(문항 복제 여부 확인 권장).
Q25 오류어 much를 넣어도 제목 ③ 근거는 유지됨.

Q25.evidence: ② much → little: 'They seem to have very much in common with ordinary people like us. However, this perception is far from the truth.' — However 뒤 반박 구조상 '공통점이 거의 없다'여야 함.
